title: BeatVersion
description: A version of a beat's text (§14 beat_version): the latest one is the current one.

chars.description: Characters incl. spaces, counted in code; line breaks are not counted.

origin.description: generated by the write role, or edited: saved or restored by the user.

checked.description: Whether its check is over (§10); false for a version whose check job failed or was stopped.

feedback.description: The user's 좋음/별로 on this version (§9), null when not rated.

feedback_note.description: The note given with the rating, null when none.
